title: Death Additions
description: This datapack adds death sounds and kill streak additions.
body:
This datapack adds sound effects whenever people die, and also a kill streak addition.
### Kill Streaks;
1. 2 kills
2. 5 kills
3. 10 kills
4. 30 kills (Reaper)
5. 100 kills (Apocalypse)
6. 500 kills (Error: 404)

### Configs
You can actually turn off the streak mode or change the language(english and turkish).

To change the language(0 is english and 1 is turkish):
```
/scoreboard players set #Server lang 0
```
To turn off streak mode(0 turns off streak mode, 1 turns it on):
```
/scoreboard players set #Server streak_toggle 1
```
